name: Accordion rows
description: A stack of five filled bars 720 wide by 88 tall at 1440 (collapsed), 20px radius, 8px gaps, 28px side padding, left-aligned in a column that sits opposite a headline or a picture. Each bar: a 22px medium question or topic of one line at the left and a 40px filled round control at the right showing a plus glyph. Open one at a time: the bar grows over 320ms to reveal a two-to-three-line 17px answer of at most 30 words at 70% ink, the glyph turns to a cross and the bar fill shifts to the accent tint. Colour roles: ground = page ground, bars = tinted ground, ink full, accent for the open state. Each bar is a sibling card, never nested.
phone: Bars full width, 76px collapsed, 24px side padding; same one-open behaviour.
houseRuleCheck: Flagged for hairlines; designed out: each row is its own filled bar with a gap, so no rules between rows; no outlined boxes.

name: Airy one-word panel
description: Two or three solid panels side by side, each 420 wide by 460 tall at 1440, square corners, 56px padding all round, so that the type floats in open fill. Each holds one word (up to nine letters) at 64px bold and, 24px below, a 18px paragraph of at most 14 words at 70% ink; nothing else. Colour roles: ground = page ground, each panel a different solid from the palette (two or three, one family), ink chosen for contrast. The row moves with scroll: the panels slide up at slightly different speeds (0.9, 1.0, 1.1 of scroll) and settle in a staggered line. Hover steps the fill one tone. Sits with generous space (at least 160px) above and below.
phone: Panels stack at full width, 360 tall, 40px padding, word at 48px; the speed difference is dropped.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. Panels are solid fills with no outline; keep the word a real word, not a number or index.

name: Figure tile, diagonal caption
description: A solid-colour tile 320 by 320 at 1440, square corners, no picture. A heavy 110px figure sits top-left, 28px in; a two-line 16px caption of up to ten words is pinned bottom-right at the same inset and right-aligned, so the eye reads the tile on its diagonal. The figure is a real claim (a speed, a share, a count of something delivered), never a step or an index. Colour roles: ground = page ground, tile = the strongest colour of the palette (the accent or an inverted ink), figure and caption in the colour that contrasts most with it. Set three such tiles in a row on 16px gaps, all in the one fill, beside or under a headline, or one tile beside a picture; never a cell in a bento grid of mixed tiles. Hover: the figure slides 8px toward the middle; entrance fade-rise with an 80ms stagger.
phone: Tiles full width at 1:1 (or two per row on a wide phone), figure 80px; the diagonal stays.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. The giant figure is a stat, not numbering; never 01/02/03. Not a bento cell (the skill fails bento grids): an even row in one fill, or one tile beside a picture.

name: Video tile, giant figure
description: A video tile 468 wide by 400 tall at 1440 (range 274-634 tall), square or 8px corners, filled edge to edge by a muted looping video that is abstract, rendered or product footage, graded dark at its left where the words sit. A heavy 120px figure sits top-left, 28px in, in warm white; a 16px caption of up to three lines sits at the bottom-left at the same inset, in the same white. If the footage has no calm dark area there, a flat black scrim at 45% covers only the figure and caption blocks (never a gradient, never a wash over the whole video). The figure is a real measured claim (a speed, a percentage, a duration), never an index or a step number. Colour roles: ink = warm white; accent unused on the tile. One tile stands beside a text block, or two side by side with a 24px gap; never a cell in a bento grid. The video plays while the tile is in view and pauses off-screen; hover slows it to half speed and nothing else moves.
phone: Tile goes full width at 4:5; figure 84px, caption 16px; the video swaps to its poster frame if data saving is on.
houseRuleCheck: Flagged for gradient; designed out: the corner gradient is gone and the words sit on a dark part of the footage or on a flat scrim under the text only. Not a bento cell (the skill fails bento grids): one or two tiles beside text. The figure is a measured value, never a counter or a 01/02 index; the video is never documentary.

name: Canvas-left framed pair
description: Two filled cards side by side, each 640 wide by 320 tall at 1440, 20px radius, 32px gap, padding 24px. In each, a live generative canvas at the left (300 by 272, 12px radius), a flowing field (noise, flow lines or particles in two palette tones; a generated image, never a hand-drawn picture), and at the right a column holding a 28px bold title of up to three lines, a 17px paragraph of three lines (at most 24 words) and a text link with a typeset arrow. Colour roles: ground = page ground, card = tinted ground (no outline), canvas = ink and accent on a darker tint, text ink dark. Hover: the canvas speed doubles over 400ms and the arrow slides 6px. The two canvases use different seeds.
phone: Cards stack; canvas on top at 16:9, text below; animation drops to a still frame if reduced motion is set.
houseRuleCheck: The 'framed' look is a filled card, not an outlined frame. The canvas is a generative field (a shader-like effect), not a drawn illustration.

name: Caption above photo
description: Four filled cards across, each 316 wide by 360 tall at 1440 on 16px gaps (container 1312), square corners, 20px side padding. Top of the card: a 18px medium title of up to two lines at the top-left, 20px in, 18px from the top; no label above it. Below it a near-square picture (ratio 1.12, 316 by 282) flush to the bottom and sides of the card. Colour roles: ground = page ground, card = tinted ground, ink dark, accent none; the pictures supply colour. Hover scales the picture 1.05 within its clip over 500ms. Static grid: it has no scroll behaviour. Pictures are one family of studio, rendered or product images.
phone: Two across, two rows, 12px gaps; the third row is a link.
houseRuleCheck: The 14px label above the title is dropped (eyebrow). No conflict left.

name: Case-study row
description: A case-study card 1312 wide by 480 tall at 1440, filled (tinted ground), 24px radius, 24px padding. At the left, a landscape picture (ratio 1.5, 640 by 432, 14px radius). At the right, inside 40px padding: a bold 32px title of up to two lines, a two-line 18px paragraph (at most 24 words) and, pinned to the bottom, a bold 48px figure (the result) with a 16px caption under it. Two or three rows stack with 64px between them; the picture alternates side from row to row so no side is empty. Colour roles: ground = page ground, card = tinted ground, ink dark, accent on the figure. Hover crossfades the picture to a second view over 400ms. Figures are real outcomes, never a counter.
phone: Picture first (4:3), then text, figure at the bottom; rows 48px apart.
houseRuleCheck: Flagged for eyebrow; designed out: the 12px label above the title is deleted.

name: Code snippet panel
description: A filled code panel 360 wide by 120 tall at 1440, 12px radius, 18px top and bottom and 20px side padding, in a dark tone (the ink, or a darkened ground) that stays one fixed colour in both themes. Five lines of real code or commands at 14px in a monospaced face, top-left, in one light ink plus at most one accent tone for a single token class; a 32px round copy button at the top-right. This is the one place a monospaced face is allowed: it is real code the visitor will copy, never decoration. Colour roles: panel = dark, ink = off-white, accent = one tone for commands. Hover reveals the copy button; click turns it into the word Copied for 1.5s. It sits beside a headline or a feature card, never as a full-width strip.
phone: Panel full width, 14px type kept, lines scroll sideways inside rather than wrapping; copy button always visible.
avoidWith: kind:other monospaced text on the page
houseRuleCheck: Flagged as monospace, but the house rule bans monospace outside code: this is genuine code, so it is allowed. Only real, copyable code counts; no decorative terminal chrome.

name: Colour-band product carousel card
description: A full-width section band in the brand colour holding a row of product cards, each 300 wide by 400 tall at 1440, 12px radius, 16px gaps, four visible and a fifth peeking 56px. The card is a filled light tint: a square picture flush at the top (300 by 300, top corners clipped by the radius), below it a caption zone with a bold 17px title of up to two lines and, under it, a 15px meta line (a price or a size) in 70% ink; no label above the title. Colour roles: ground = the brand-colour band, cards = a light tint, ink dark on the cards, accent for the arrow buttons. The row moves 316px per click of two 48px filled round buttons at the bottom right; no scroll track. Hover lifts the card 8px.
phone: Cards 220 by 320, 1.5 visible, native swipe, buttons hidden.
houseRuleCheck: Flagged for eyebrow; designed out: the 14px label above the title is dropped and the meta line moves below. The band is a filled ground, no outline.

name: Multi-field form panel
description: A filled form panel 560 wide by about 600 tall at 1440, 16px radius, 48px padding. A 32px bold title at the top, then a two-column grid of fields on a 16px gap (first and last name; email and a second short field), then one full-width message field of four lines, then a full-width submit button 56px tall in the accent. Fields are filled one tone darker than the panel, 52px tall, 12px radius, no outline; the placeholder at 16px carries the label. Colour roles: ground = page ground, panel = tinted ground or the brand colour, ink full, accent on the button. Focus gives a 2px accent ring. Sits at one side of the section opposite a short text block with the contact details, so no side is empty.
phone: Fields go one column, panel full width with 28px padding.
houseRuleCheck: Filled fields instead of outlined boxes, so no conflict.

name: Title-and-button panel
description: A square filled panel 480 by 480 at 1440, 12px radius, 24px padding, with a bold 30px title of three to four words and one button (48px high, dealt style) at the top-left; the rest of the square stays empty fill on purpose (a held breath inside the panel). It stands beside one picture of the same height, the two making the row; never alone and never as a cell in a grid of tiles (a half-empty cell in a grid reads as a bento). Colour roles: ground = page ground, panel = the accent or brand colour, ink and button in the contrasting pair. Hover: the fill shifts to a second tone over 300ms and the button arrow slides 6px. The empty area must stay empty: no illustration, no icon, no second paragraph. A wider version, 640x480 with the title top-left and the button pinned to the bottom-left, does the same beside a 640x480 picture.
phone: Full width, 4:3, the title and button at the top-left unchanged.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. A box of mostly empty fill is intended, so it always stands beside a picture of its own height and never in a grid of tiles (the skill fails half-empty bento cells); the page is not made only of boxes.

name: Cutout feature with price
description: A single feature card 486 wide by 634 tall at 1440, square corners, a solid tint fill. A cutout (a product or object on transparent ground, ratio 1.25, 486 by 389) sits at the top and bleeds slightly off the top edge; below it, centred: a 40px bold name of one to three words, a 26px price or figure in the accent colour, and a button 48px high in the dealt style. 40px padding. Colour roles: ground = page ground, card = a soft tint of the palette (or the accent at 15%), ink dark, accent for the price and button. Hover turns the cutout 3 degrees and scales it 1.04 over 500ms; on scroll the cutout floats 24px against the card. The card is the single hero product of a section, placed beside a short text block.
phone: Card full width, 560 tall, name 32px, price 22px; the float is dropped.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. The cutout is a real image on transparent ground; no drawn product.

name: Cutout over title, wide gap
description: Two cards side by side with a very wide gap of 160-200px, in alternating sizes: a large card 640 wide and a small one 420 wide, the small one dropped 120px lower so the pair zigzags. Each card is a filled panel (a soft tint, square corners) holding a cutout (a product or object photographed on transparent ground, ratio 0.88) centred in the upper 70%, then a 24px medium title, a button at 44px high and a 16px meta line (price, size or date) at 70% ink, all left-aligned inside 32px padding. Colour roles: ground = page ground; each panel a different soft tint from the palette (two at most); ink dark; accent on the button fill only. On hover the cutout lifts 12px and turns 2 degrees over 400ms; on scroll the small card travels 40px faster than the large one.
phone: Cards stack, large first, both full width; the vertical stagger is dropped and the 160px gap becomes 48px.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. The cutouts must be real product or object images on transparent ground, not drawn shapes.

name: Dated log rows
description: A list of six to eight filled bars, each 1312 wide by 72 tall at 1440, 18px radius, 6px apart, 16px top and bottom and 28px side padding. Columns: a 16px date in 60% ink in a fixed 140px column at the left; a 22px medium title of three to eight words in the middle; a filled chip (14px sentence case, 32px tall, fully rounded, one tone darker than the bar) at the right. Dates are real dates, not an index. Colour roles: ground = page ground, bars = tinted ground, ink dark, accent on hover. Hover: the bar fill moves to the accent tint, the title slides 8px right and the chip fills with the accent. Ends with one text link to see all.
phone: Bars become two-line cards: title first, date and chip on a second line; height auto, same gaps.
houseRuleCheck: Flagged for hairlines; designed out: each row is a filled bar with a gap, no rules. The 12px type is lifted to 14-22px and the 20-row list shortened to eight.

name: Dot bullet rows
description: Four filled bars 640 wide by 88 tall at 1440, 20px radius, 8px apart, 28px left and 32px right padding. In each: a 12px solid dot in the accent colour (a plain bullet, not an icon) and, 20px to its right, one sentence at 20px of up to twelve words in ink on a single line. Colour roles: ground = page ground, bars = tinted ground, ink dark, accent only for the dots. Hover: the dot grows to 16px, the bar fill steps one tone and the bar shifts 8px to the right over 250ms; on entrance the bars drop in with 70ms stagger. Used beside a headline or a picture for a short list of promises or facts, with 120px of open ground on the other side.
phone: Bars full width, 76px tall, sentence may wrap to two lines at 18px; hover shift dropped.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. The dot is a typographic bullet in the accent, not a drawn shape or an icon; keep the list to four so it is not a wall of boxes.

name: Filled feature card, picture on top
description: Three feature cards across, each 416 wide and about 440 tall at 1440 on 32px gaps. Each card is a filled surface (ground stepped one tone toward ink, 24px radius, 32px padding). On top sits a picture crop 352 by 200 at 12px radius: a rendered object, a close studio shot or a cropped piece of the real product screen (never an icon, never a drawn symbol). Under it, left-aligned, a 26px medium title, a three-to-four-line 17px paragraph at 70% ink (at most 28 words) and an optional text link with a typeset arrow in the accent colour. Colour roles: ground = page ground, card = tinted ground, ink full for the title, accent for the link only. On hover the card fill moves one tone and the arrow slides 6px right; entrance is a 70ms stagger fade-rise.
phone: Cards stack one per row at full width, picture 16:9; titles drop to 24px; if there are more than three, the rest scroll in a swipeable row.
houseRuleCheck: The first version is an unboxed column with an icon on top: it conflicts with the cards-for-grouping rule and the no-icon-topped-cards ban. Designed out: a filled card and a picture crop replace the bare column and the icon; the idea (left-aligned feature column with title, paragraph and link) is kept.

name: Feature panel with canvas strip
description: Two filled panels side by side, each 640 wide by 440 tall at 1440, 20px radius, 24px padding, 32px gap. At the top a thin animated strip (592 by 84, about 7:1, 12px radius) of a generative field (flowing noise, particles or a looping shader in two palette tones; generated, never hand-drawn shapes). Below: a 26px bold title, a one-line 18px lead, a list of three items at 17px (four to seven words each, 10px apart, no bullets or icons) and a button at the bottom-left. Colour roles: ground = page ground, panel = tinted ground, strip = ink and accent on a dark tint, ink dark. Hover: the panel fill steps one tone and the strip speeds up 1.5 times; entrance is a fade-rise.
phone: Panels stack; strip 56px tall; the list keeps three items; reduced motion shows a still.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. The strip is a generative field (a shader-type effect), not a drawn illustration; the list has no icons.

name: Filled title-sub block
description: A solid filled block 350 wide by 240 tall at 1440, square corners, 24px padding: a bold 34px title of one to four words and, 12px below, a 16px line of three to ten words at 75% ink; at the bottom-right a typeset arrow glyph at 28px. Used as a row of three or four such blocks on 8px gaps, all in one solid fill (or two alternating), beside a picture or under a headline so the section is not boxes only. Colour roles: ground = page ground, blocks = one solid palette fill, ink chosen for contrast, accent none. Hover: the arrow slides 8px right and the fill steps one tone over 250ms. The tight padding and bold title are the idea; do not add an icon.
phone: Two across at 160 tall, or full width stacked at 120 tall; arrow stays.
houseRuleCheck: The hover arrow is a typeset glyph, not an icon. One fill (or two alternating), never a wall of tiles in several fills; paired with a picture or a headline so the section is not boxes only.

name: Full-screen panel, photo left
description: A full-screen panel 1312 wide by 860 tall at 1440 (inset 64px from the sides, 24px radius), solid fill, 64px padding. At the left a portrait picture (ratio 0.9, 560 by 620 at 14px radius), vertically centred. At the right the text column spreads top to bottom: a 56px bold title of up to two lines, then a 18px paragraph of at most 40 words, then a list of three to four items at 20px (three to six words each, 16px apart, no bullets or numbers), and a button at the bottom. No label above the title. Colour roles: ground = page ground, panel = the brand tint, ink dark, accent on the button. Scroll-linked: the panel pins for one screen of scroll while the picture scales 0.92 to 1 and the list items arrive with 120ms stagger. At least 160px of ground above and below.
phone: No pin; picture on top at 4:5, text below, list stays; 40px padding.
houseRuleCheck: Flagged for eyebrow; designed out: the 21px label is deleted. The panel is inset from both sides, so nothing meets a screen edge.

name: Full-screen title over inset video
description: A full-screen panel, 1440 wide by 900 tall, solid fill, 32px side padding. At the top-left, a 80px bold title of two words (a single line) and a text link with a typeset arrow on the same baseline at the right; below, a muted video inset 32px from the panel edges (1376 by about 520, 24px radius) fills the lower part. Colour roles: ground = the panel's solid tint (differs from the page ground), ink dark, accent on the link, the video brings its own colour. Scroll-linked: the panel pins for 1.2 screens while the video grows from 0.82 to full width and its top edge rises toward the title. The video is designed (product, render, abstract motion), never documentary. Follow with at least 160px of open ground.
phone: No pin; title 44px, video 4:5 below it at 16px side padding; plays when centred.
houseRuleCheck: Flagged for edge-touch (about 5px side padding in the first version); designed out: side padding is 32px at 1440 and 16px on a phone so the video never meets a screen edge.

name: Full-viewport video, giant title
description: A full-viewport video card, 1440 by 900, edge to edge on both sides (never one side only), muted and looping, graded or chosen dark in its lower-left where the title sits; failing that, a flat black scrim at 45% covers only the title block (never a gradient, never a wash over the whole video). A 120px bold title of one to three words sits bottom-left, 64px in from the left and from the bottom, in warm white on a single line. Colour roles: ground = the video, ink = warm white, accent unused. Nothing else is on it. On scroll the title rises 40px against the video and the video scales from 1.08 to 1.0. It is a section in the middle or at the end of a page, never the hero, and it needs at least 160px of ground before and after.
phone: Video full-screen portrait crop, title 56px bottom-left at 24px inset, poster on data saving.
avoidWith: kind:a full-bleed hero video on the same page
houseRuleCheck: Flagged for gradient; designed out: the 20% bottom gradient is gone; the title sits on a dark part of the footage or on a flat scrim under the title only. The footage is designed motion, never documentary.

name: Wide colour panel, inset photo
description: A colour panel across the container, 1312 by 700 at 1440, 24px radius, in the brand colour. At the left, 64px inset: a bold 46px title of up to two lines, an 18px paragraph of one to two lines (at most 20 words), and a button at 48px high. At the right a landscape picture (ratio 1.63, 680 by 417, 16px radius) inset 48px from the panel's right and top and vertically centred. No label above the title. Colour roles: ground = page ground, panel = the brand colour, ink = the colour that contrasts with it, accent = the button (inverse of the panel). Hover: the picture scales 1.03 inside the clip and the button arrow slides 6px. On scroll the picture eases 24px upward.
phone: Text above, picture below at 4:3 with 24px inset; the panel keeps its radius.
houseRuleCheck: Flagged for eyebrow; designed out: the 14px label is deleted; the picture is on a flat colour panel, not under a box.

name: Full-width CTA block
description: A filled block across the container, 1312 by 420 at 1440, 24px radius, in the brand colour or the accent. Centred: two short lines of 22px type (at most 14 words together, the first in full ink, the second in 75% ink) and, 28px below them, one button 56px high in the inverse colours. Nothing else, no picture, no icon. Colour roles: ground = page ground, block = brand colour, ink = contrasting, button = inverse of the block. Hover: the block fill moves one tone and the button arrow slides 6px; entrance is a fade-rise of the text then the button, 80ms apart. Use once near the end of the page, with 160px of open ground above and the footer below.
phone: Block full width, 320 tall, 24px side padding; lines at 20px; button full width.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. One block only; not repeated through the page.

name: Full-width pill bars
description: A stack of five or six filled bars, each 1312 wide by 84 tall at 1440, fully rounded ends (42px radius), 12px apart, 40px side padding. In each: a heavy 28px two-word label at the left; at the right a 16px chip (a category or a figure, a darker tone of the bar, 36px tall, fully rounded) and a 44px filled round arrow button. The bars take three tints of one palette family in rotation. Colour roles: ground = page ground, bars = tints, ink dark, accent on hover. Hover: the bar fill goes to the accent, the ink flips and the bar grows 8px taller over 250ms, pushing the others apart. Bars are siblings and never contain another box.
phone: Bars 68 tall, label 22px, chip hidden, the arrow stays; hover growth off.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. A page that is only these bars would be boxes only, so pair them with a picture or a type section.

name: Huge photo, small caption
description: A near-full-width picture across the container, 1312 wide by 1000 tall at 1440 (about 1.1 screens), square corners. The caption sits on the picture's calm, dark lower-left; failing that, a flat black scrim at 45% covers only the caption block (never a gradient, never a wash over the whole picture). Bottom-left, 48px in: a 28px bold title of up to two lines and, 10px below, a 16px meta line; both in warm white; no label line above. The picture is the whole event: no other element in the section. Scroll-linked: as the card passes the screen the picture inside translates 12% (inner parallax) so it reads as a window. Colour roles: ground = page ground, picture supplies everything, ink = warm white. Studio, rendered or product imagery only, never documentary.
phone: Picture 4:5 at container width, caption 20px bottom-left at 24px inset; parallax 6%.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. The first version has three text levels in a corner; here two (title and meta).

name: Full-width stat trio
description: A panel across the container, 1312 by 660 at 1440, 24px radius, in the brand colour, 56px top and 48px side padding. At the top-left a 44px bold headline of up to two lines. Along the bottom, three real figures in three equal columns, each a 120px bold figure (a percentage, a duration or a count, never numbering) with an 18px label of two to four words under it. Colour roles: ground = page ground, panel = brand colour, ink = the contrasting colour, accent = the figures (or ink if the panel is the accent). The figures fade-rise in with 120ms stagger on entry; no count-up. Hover: nothing. At least 160px of ground above and below.
phone: Figures stack one per row at 88px with their labels; panel padding 28px.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. The figures are measured claims with labels; no 01/02/03 steps and no count-up counter.

name: Thin full-width CTA strip
description: A filled strip across the container, 1312 by 110 at 1440, 20px radius, in the brand colour or accent. One row, centred: a 20px line of at most eight words and, 32px to its right, a button 48px high in the inverse colours. No label, no icon. Colour roles: ground = page ground, strip = brand colour, ink contrasting, button inverse. Hover: the strip fill moves one tone and the arrow slides 6px. Sits near the end of the page above the footer, or between two long sections as a breath; it is never above the navigation and never a bar at the very top. Needs 120px of open ground above and below. A quieter version sets the line at the left and the button at the right on the neutral fill one tone off the ground, as the link to a full list.
phone: Strip becomes a 140px card: line above, button full width below.
houseRuleCheck: The 14px label of the first version is dropped. It is not a banner or announcement bar: it sits in the page flow, never over the navigation.

name: Video slab, centred giant title
description: A project slab across the container, 1312 by 760 at 1440, 24px radius, a solid tint fill with a muted video inset 40px (radius 20px). Centred over the video: a 120px bold title of one to three words on one line, and 12px under it a 22px sentence-case line naming the kind of work; both warm white, on a calm, dark middle of the footage or on a flat black scrim at 45% under the two lines only (never a gradient, never a wash over the whole video); no index or number. One slab per screen. Colour roles: ground = page ground, slab = brand tint, ink = warm white. Scroll-linked: the video's inset eases from 84px to 24px as the slab reaches the centre of the screen, so it grows into the slab, and the title scales 0.94 to 1. The video is rendered, product or abstract, never documentary.
phone: Slab 560 tall, video inset 16px, title 56px; grows into place with a smaller range.
houseRuleCheck: Flagged for numbering; designed out: the 12px index is deleted; the title stays centred with a sentence-case line under it.

name: Gapless near-square photo row
description: A strip of near-square cards (ratio 0.9) 440 wide and 490 tall at 1440, three visible, laid with a 2px gap so they read as one continuous band, a fourth peeking 80px from the right edge. Each card is a filled column: the photo flush at the top with square corners, then a 72px caption band in the same fill holding one 20px medium title, left-aligned at 24px inset. Colour roles: ground = page ground, card fill = a tint of the ground, ink full; accent appears only on the arrow buttons. The strip moves by two 48px filled round arrow buttons at the bottom right (no visible track or progress bar), 440px per step with a 500ms ease. On hover the card lifts 10px; neighbours stay still. Pictures are studio or product images of one family.
phone: Cards 280 wide, 1.3 visible, swipe natively with scroll-snap; arrows hidden; the 2px gap stays.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict. The title sits in a filled caption band under the photo, not on the photo; arrows are the only control and there is no rail or progress line.

name: Gapless portrait strip
description: A continuous band of thirteen portrait pictures (ratio 0.8, 250 by 313 at 1440) with no gaps, so it reads as one long image strip; radius 8px only at the two ends of the strip, 0 between pictures. No text. The strip is wider than the screen (3250px) and is panned sideways by scroll: it travels about 1900px across the section's pass, no pin, no visible rail or progress. Pictures are a set of one family (a series of products, renders or abstract studies) with a shared tone so the joins are felt, not seen. Colour roles: ground = page ground, pictures supply all colour. Hover dims neighbours to 85% for the picture under the pointer.
phone: Tiles 160 by 200 at the same pan; native scroll-linked, no hover.
houseRuleCheck: The first version holds drawn illustrations; here the pictures are rendered or product images. No drag rail or progress bar.

name: Giant one-line title rows
description: A stacked list of five or six rows, each 140 tall at 1440 with 12px between them, holding one centred 110px title of one to three words (a single line, no media), set directly on the page ground with no rules. The list is the section's whole structure and has 160px of ground above and below. Colour roles: ground = page ground, ink full, accent = the hover fill. Hover: the hovered row gets a filled bar behind it (28px radius, accent) and its ink flips, while the other rows drop to 35% ink over 300ms. At the left of each row a wide mark (2.5:1, 200x80), a client or product wordmark as a supplied logo or typeset in the display face, on the row fill. To its right a 28px bold two-line title and a one-line 17px description at 65% ink. No label. Hover: the row fill turns accent, the ink flips and the mark scales to 1.05. Rows rise 24px with an 80ms stagger. Phone: the mark 120x48 above the title, rows 12px apart, headline above the list.
phone: Mark above the title at 120x48, rows 12px apart, headline above the list.
houseRuleCheck: The 11px two-line label (an eyebrow) is dropped. A mark is a typeset or supplied logo, not a drawn glyph or icon. The sticky headline keeps the left of the section filled.

name: Wide logo roster panel
description: One centred filled panel, 1000x300 at 1440, 24px radius, 40px padding, tint fill, with a 28px bold title of two words centred on top and two centred rows of three marks (no more than six) at about 150x40 each, 40px apart, in ink at 80%. Marks are supplied logo files or typeset wordmarks in one weight. The panel sits alone with 160px of ground above and below; it is never a footer block and never a long wall of credits. Entering: the marks fade in with a 60ms stagger. Hover: a mark rises to full ink and the others dim to 40%. Phone: the panel full width, 24px padding, marks in a 2x3 grid at 110px wide.
phone: Panel full width, marks in a 2x3 grid at 110px wide, 24px padding.
houseRuleCheck: A logo panel can slide into a credit wall: limit it to six marks, keep it out of the footer and give it its own space. No outline, no hairline; the fill is the container.

name: Wide-mat square video
description: One square-cornered tint panel, 560x560 at 1440, with a square video (432x432) inset in a 64px mat, so the picture floats like a framed artwork. No text on the card; a one-line 17px caption can sit on the ground under it. Placed off-centre in the right seven columns while the left five hold a 56px headline, or as a staggered pair with the second panel 120px lower. Video muted and looped, starting when in view. Hover: the video scales to 1.06 inside its clip and the mat deepens a tone over 600ms. Entering: the panel scales from 0.92 to 1. Phone: panel full width, mat 24px, headline above.
phone: Panel full width, mat 24px, headline above, video plays when in view.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict: a thick filled mat (not an outline), no overlay, no text over the video.

name: Wide-mat video with caption
description: Three square-cornered tint panels across the 1312 container, each 400x350 at 1440, 56px gaps. A landscape video (1.8, 336x187) sits in a 32px mat at the top; under it a bold 24px title of up to two lines and a 16px one-line descriptor at 65% ink, left-aligned inside the 32px padding. Videos muted, looped, playing only in view. Scroll-linked: the three panels rise in sequence, 60px, 30px and 0px lower, levelling as the row passes the centre. Hover: the panel fill steps a tone and the video scales to 1.05 inside the mat. Phone: stacked, 14px gaps, title 22px.
phone: Stacked, 14px gaps, title 22px, descriptor one line.
houseRuleCheck: The 14px label is lifted to 16px sentence case; the mat is a filled panel margin, not an outline.

name: Wide rounded banner
description: One wide photograph banner across the container, 1312x656 at 1440 (2:1), 24px radius. At the bottom-left on 48px padding, on the picture's calm, dark part (or on a flat black scrim at 45% under the title only, never a gradient or a wash over the whole picture), a bold 64px title of up to two lines in the ground colour; no label above it. A 52px pill button sits at the bottom-right. Scroll-linked: the photograph scales from 1.15 to 1.0 inside its clip as the banner crosses the view. Hover: the button fills with the accent. Entering: the banner scales from 0.96 to 1 and the title rises 30px. Phone: full width at 4:5, title 32px, button under the title.
phone: Full width at 4:5, title 32px, button under the title.
houseRuleCheck: The gradient over the bottom 30% is gone: the title sits on the photograph's calm part or on a flat scrim under the title only. The 14px label is dropped. A banner photograph must be staged or lit, not documentary.

name: Short split, inset video
description: One short wide card across the container, 1100x320 at 1440, 24px radius, tint fill, 16px padding, centred. The left half holds one three-line 26px paragraph of at most 25 words, vertically centred on 48px side padding. The right half holds a wide muted video (1.76, 520x296) with a 12px radius inset flush with the padding, looping while in view. Hover: the video scales to 1.04 inside its clip and the card fill steps a tone. Entering: the card rises 30px and the video unveils with a clip wipe from the right. Phone: stacked, video on top at 16:9, paragraph 20px below, 16px padding.
phone: Stacked, video above at 16:9, paragraph 20px, 16px padding.
houseRuleCheck: The 14px text is lifted to 26px and cut to one short paragraph. No conflict beyond that.

name: Wide split, square photo left
description: One card across the container, 1312x640 at 1440, 28px radius, tint fill, 20px padding. A square photograph (600x600) fills the left at full height and shares the 20px inner radius. The right column, on 48px padding, splits top and bottom: a 56px bold two-line title at the top and, pinned to the bottom, a two-line 17px paragraph with a 64px filled pill link tile with a 17px label and a typeset arrow. Hover: the photograph scales to 1.04 inside its clip and the link tile fills with the accent. Entering: the photograph unveils with a clip wipe from the left and the text rises 24px. Phone: photograph on top at 1:1, text below, title 32px.
phone: Photograph on top at 1:1, text below, title 32px, link tile full width.
houseRuleCheck: No conflict: filled card, photograph inside it, a filled link tile. The photograph must be staged or lit, not documentary.
